{{Quote|If there's one thing collectors want, it's a blast rifle&mdash;the forefather of blaster weapons. Blast rifles are ''very'' primitive compared to today's weapons, but ''stang'' would I love to get hold of a couple&mdash;one to sell off at an extravagant price and one to keep for myself.|[[Itlar|Dr. Itlar]]|<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
The '''blast-rifle''' was a type of weapon used during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> At the time, they were the latest innovation in weapons technology and fired short [[Laser/Legends|laser]] beams that inflicted severe heat damage on their targets. [[Core World Arms]] manufactured the [[BR1-Z]] blast-rifle.<ref name="TotJCompanion" /> Blast-rifles were wielded by the [[Beast Riders]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|78|blast-rifle}}</ref>

Blast-rifles were considered to be the forerunners to the modern [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Weapons collectors highly prized blast-rifles, and they could sell for extremely high prices.<ref name="Gundark" />
